source.name: Audi Revolut F1 Team – Glasurit becomes exclusive paint supplier of Audi Revolut F1 Team for 2026 debut
source.quote: Audi Revolut F1 Team today confirms Glasurit, the premium refinish paint brand of BASF Coatings, as its exclusive and official paint supplier

note: Audi Revolut F1 Team partner on the 2026 car.
